method: R13 scale-growth benchmark. Main metric process.cpuUsage() (user+system). Independent child process per (round, side, workload, sample), alternating A,B / B,A; A = baseline a0380e5cf2761297ecd8ffe1c79e34865ac6baee, B = candidate worktree. All fixtures are fresh mkdtemp roots; no DSH_HOME / real data touched. Curves are single-side (candidate) measurements at 3 scales; A/B compares the two changed paths and two unchanged controls. Fingerprints and stats are asserted equal per round. Concurrency uses real child processes sharing one store.
